name: Ancient Blade
description: A centuries-old forged katana of unmatched balance, said to carry the ancestral fortune of vanished clans.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector game icon. Pure solid pitch-black silhouette of an ancient heirloom samurai katana sword blade with curved scabbard and engraved golden dragon habaki hilt collar. Centered completely inside a giant solid flat bright crimson red circular sun disc (#FF2035). Pure solid pitch-black background (#000000). Razor-sharp vector edges, duotone black and crimson, no 3D rendering, no text, no watermark.
